request.style: English, doom metal, crushing slow distorted guitars, heavy drums, a deep clean baritone voice turning to a roar at the climax, tragic and heavy, minor key, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They put out my eyes and bound me in bronze
Grinding at the mill in the prison of Gaza
My hair began to grow again
While they feasted to their god Dagon

[Chorus]
Lord God, remember me
Strengthen me only this once
Let me die with the Philistines
Lord God, remember me

[Verse]
They called me out to make them sport
Three thousand on the roof to watch
A boy led me by the hand
Let me feel the pillars where the house stands

[Chorus]
Lord God, remember me
Strengthen me only this once
Let me die with the Philistines
Lord God, remember me

[Verse]
I grasped the two middle pillars
One with my right hand, one with my left
I bowed with all my might
And the house fell down
